status: draft for parts B and C: not frozen; nothing of B or C has been trained
data: synthetic everywhere; nothing here is market data

causal.data: synthetic: Hawkes market orders from examples/hawkes_days.rs moving the mid by a linear impact plus a diffusion; made-up parameters
causal.seed: 1000003 + day for the day's flow (buy side 2 x seed, sell side 2 x seed + 1) and diffusion, the same in every setting
causal.note: one policy per arm and impact setting, on that setting's training days

market.data: synthetic: the #102 queue-reactive days (3 regimes x 24), whose holdout #102 has already read; one policy per arm on the pooled training days, as #102

execution.rest: #102's main execution otherwise: fee 0.0002, limits max position 20 and max notional 2500, terminal mark, the 5 x 5 x 2 grid with the mask policy

window.rule: each market feature's normalized value and its presence flag are channels; ages are in decisions; the agent's values and flags are scalars

mlp.note: the #102 control: the current observation only

parameters.rule: the #102 MaskablePPO MLP's trainable parameter count; each arm's policy and value MLPs have two hidden layers of the width nearest it

references.note: the points #102 selected, not reselected here; volatility by #102's rule from each part's training days

decision_rule.against: the best non-HSN learned arm by mean daily net on validation, chosen before the holdout
decision_rule.interval: 90 % block bootstrap over days on the paired daily difference, a learned arm's day being the mean over its seeds
decision_rule.hsn_helps: the lower bound is above 0, HSN has no limit breach, its mean max drawdown is at most drawdown_factor times the control's, and its interval against no-trade excludes 0
decision_rule.applied: B per regime and pooled; C per impact setting

audit.rule: a fixed set from the first validation day under a hold; two loads of every frozen checkpoint must give identical actions
